name: OpenFillAction
description: Dutch-auction swap: offers its whole input for a flat demandPerFill of the demanded token, and any filler can take it. It has no cap of its own: feed it from a stream with a maxBudget, which sets the worst price (demandPerFill over the most the node can receive). Restarts its budget when the manager changes demandPerFill, so it needs CHECKPOINT_PERMISSION_ID on that budget.

dependencies.name: budget
dependencies.description: The flow's stream budget, restarted when the demand changes: the index of an earlier Budget component in the recipe.

settings.name: demandedToken
settings.description: The token the DAO must receive: an ERC20 (use WETH for ether). Native ETH isn't supported.

settings.name: demandPerFill
settings.description: How much of the demanded token must come back per fill.

initialization: Setup supplies [flowBudget] as deps; this action uses it.
